method.method_draft: Use a local surface-area cancellation argument. From the image, note that the original solid is a long rectangular prism labeled 9 ft by 3 ft by 1 ft, and the removed piece is a 1 ft cube cut from the top edge, passing through the full 1 ft thickness of the prism. From the text, use that exactly one one-foot cube is removed and compare the new surface area with the original. All unchanged faces can be ignored. The cut removes three 1-by-1 exterior square patches from the old surface, and it exposes three new 1-by-1 square faces inside the notch. Since the removed area is 3 square feet and the added area is 3 square feet, the total surface area changes by 0 square feet, so it is the same.
